name: Stinkdrinker Warren
description: A warren of friendly, colorful boggarts in a swamp on the Wanderwine who host Maralen and lend a boat.

description_citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
description_citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The coracle reaches the Stinkdrinker Warren, where Ashling pulls Maralen ashore.
timeline.quote: A four-fingered hand made of what looked like flexible black glass caught her wrist and tugged her onto solid ground.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells Ashling their story, and Ashling reveals the elves and Morcant plan to kill the night beast with poisons.
timeline.quote: They're concocting a plan to kill the creature.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen rejects ending the night forever, saying eternal day is Oona's way, and Ashling agrees to help stop the elves.
timeline.quote: Eternal day is Oona's way, not my own.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The blue-and-green faerie eavesdrops on the conversation and flies off.
timeline.quote: It flicked back and forth between blue and green

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

relations.note: Maralen says she has friends in this bog and the boggarts lend a boat.
relations.quote: I have friends in this bog.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.
